folder_html:
LIVE SOLAR RADIATION

Modeled incoming sunlight energy at the surface (broadband: includes ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared solar energy). This is not a UV Index and not a visible-light meter reading. An hourly weather-model estimate, not a ground sensor measurement at every location. Nighttime reads zero (valid data, near-black) — not missing data. Clouds reduce values quantitatively versus clear sky.
